mentions.name: Rootly Burnout Detector
mentions.description: A burnout detector for SREs that helps teams identify incident responders who may be overworked or getting burned out. It combines objective signals from incident management tools (Rootly/PagerDuty), GitHub, and Slack with self-reported survey data to generate a Copenhagen Burnout Inventory (CBI) score. The tool is fully open-source and can be tested locally, with an alternative hosted version using mock data.
mentions.problem: Teams lack a way to identify incident responders who may be overworked or getting burned out.
mentions.audience: SRE teams and incident responders, with particularly positive feedback from managers of large and distributed organizations
